description: Kinder Morgan, Inc. is one of the largest energy infrastructure companies in North America, and as of December 31, 2025 it owned an interest in or operated approximately 78,000 miles of pipelines, 136 terminals, approximately 706 Bcf of working natural gas storage capacity, and RNG generation capacity of approximately 6.9 Bcf per year of gross production. Its pipelines transport natural gas, refined petroleum products, crude oil, condensate, CO2, renewable fuels and other products, and its terminals store and handle various commodities including gasoline, diesel fuel, jet fuel, chemicals, petroleum coke, metals, and ethanol and other renewable fuels and feedstocks.
